M-CLI-ENTRY.Summary: Top-level CLI entry point; wires subcommands and handles Bun shebang execution.

M-CLI-LINT.Summary: Implements grace lint — validates GRACE artifacts, semantic markup, unique tags, and skill-section discipline.

M-CLI-MODULE.Summary: Implements grace module find and grace module show.

M-CLI-FILE.Summary: Implements grace file show — file-local MODULE_CONTRACT, MODULE_MAP, and semantic blocks.

M-CLI-STATUS.Summary: Implements grace status with text/json output — artifact health, module/verification counts, change-bundle states, and next action. Primary consumer: SessionStart hook injected by grace-init.

M-CLI-AFK.Summary: Implements grace afk — autonomous-harness subcommands (start/tick/ask/check/journal/defer/increment/report/stop). CLI enforces session time budget; agents cannot rationalize past it.

M-CLI-EVOLVE.Summary: Implements grace evolve — init / run / show subcommands for evolutionary search over candidate solutions. MVP without LLM-critic loop.
